name: Pages under a parent, their grid rows and paragraphs

mcpOnly.reason: Pages are found, created, titled and pinned with MCP tools, and rows and paragraphs are verified with them, but the save_grid_rows and save_paragraphs request wrappers and the get_paragraph_item_field_values response are not documented in this repo; those bindings are planned.

hosted.reason: Nothing here needs SQL, but rows, paragraphs and their item fields cannot be created until the planned MCP bindings are documented; on a hosted install pages apply and the rest verifies.

steps.title: Ensure each page under its parent by menu text

bindings.reason: PageSave is documented only as a round trip of a full GetPageById model; no create model is documented.

steps.trap: The create path of save_pages answers id 0: the new page's id is read back by parent and menu text, never taken from the response. itemType goes on the create call; added later it mints no item.

steps.title: Give each created page a Title equal to its menu text
steps.trap: On an item-typed page every save re-derives the menu text from the item's title field, reorder_pages included, so the Title is the only durable label.

steps.title: Pin each created page's url name after the Title write
steps.trap: A Title write on a page without a pinned url name moves its address. save_pages persists urlName but no page read projects it, so the read-back checks the menu text and only the served URL proves the slug, after polling it to 200 for at least 15 seconds.

steps.title: Ensure each grid row on its page by sort, with its definition and container

bindings.reason: save_grid_rows members (id, pageId, container, definitionId, itemType, sort) are documented, but the repo writes the call both flat and as a list and never names the request member; read it from tools/list, record it, then promote.
GridRowCopy {PageId, Id} needs a donor row and five normalising writes (paragraphs, spacing, template, sort, width); no single create shape is documented.

steps.trap: container is load-bearing: a row saved under a container the layout does not render is stored, reads back, and puts nothing on the page while it answers HTTP 200. Take it from get_layout_containers.

steps.title: Ensure each paragraph in its row by sort, with its item type and column

bindings.reason: save_paragraphs members (id, pageId, itemType, template, gridRowId, gridRowColumn, sort) are documented, but the request member is not; read it from tools/list, record it, then promote.

steps.trap: A cell renders exactly one paragraph, and the create path answers id 0 with the minted itemId; save_paragraphs does not map active before MCP 0.6.5.

steps.title: Write each paragraph's item fields, button fields blanked or full JSON

bindings.reason: get_paragraph_item_field_values takes paragraphId, but its response shape is not documented in this repo, so no field can be compared.
set_paragraph_item_fields {paragraphId, fields: {SystemName: value}} is documented, but its read-back needs the undocumented get_paragraph_item_field_values response.

steps.trap: set_paragraph_item_fields counts the fields it was asked to write, not the ones it matched: a misspelt system name answers succeeded. A bare create stores the item type's string defaults in button fields, which render a ConverterException inside an HTTP 200 page.

probes.title: Each page exists exactly once under its parent
Each grid row carries the container the input names
A public page answers 200 anonymously at its path, with no render error

bindings.reason: fetch_frontend_page_html is not on the read allowlist, its argument name is not documented in this repo, and no rendered-markup assertion is implemented.
A page path is not a delivery route: the anonymous GET allowlist holds /dwapi routes only, and the navigation route's projection is not measured.

traps: Never carry a page id between runs or hosts: ids are minted per host and a deserialize re-mints them. Pages are found by parent and menu text at the point of use.

Read the item type, row definition, container and template names from get_item_types, get_row_definitions, get_layout_containers and get_paragraph_templates (areaId always passed); a misnamed argument answers only 'An error occurred invoking'.
On a multi-language website every save on the master creates the mirror with the structure and not the field values; write on the master, then set the mirror's values.
A URL answers 404 for several seconds after a correct save; poll it to 200 before reading a 404 as a failure.
